in_sanskrit.name: Shek
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of Fortune
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Shek एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Shek is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sri' which means wealth, prosperity, and fortune. In Hinduism, the god of wealth and prosperity is known as 'Lakshmi', and the name Shek is a reference to her husband, Lord Vishnu. The name Shek is believed to bring good fortune, prosperity, and success in all areas of life.
